howto: Pick Easy, Medium, Hard or the Daily puzzle and press Play.
Tap an empty square, then tap a number (or type 1 to 9).
Every row, every column and every 3x3 box must hold 1 to 9 exactly once.
Yellow numbers are given; a red number is a mistake.
tips: Look for a square whose row, column and box already hold eight different numbers.
Pick a number and scan: if it can only go in one square of a row, it goes there.
Turn on notes (the pencil) to jot down every candidate in a hard square.
Hint names the next move that logic proves, and why; tap it again to fill that square.
Undo takes back a number, a note or an erase, but a mistake still counts.

controls.keyboard: Arrow keys move, 1 to 9 fill, Backspace erases, N toggles notes, Z undoes, H hints. P or Esc pauses.
controls.touch: Tap a square, then a number. Erase, notes, undo, hint and New sit under the pad.

difficulty: Easy starts with 42 numbers, Medium 34 and Hard 28, and every puzzle has exactly one solution. The Daily puzzle is a Medium grid that is the same for everyone today.

cheats.effect: Auto notes: every empty square gets its candidates pencilled in
Fill box: one unfinished 3x3 box fills itself

features.hints: The bulb button: explains the next logically forced square (a naked or hidden single), points at it, and fills it on a second tap; also in Pause > Hint
features.undo: The undo button (or Z) takes back numbers, notes and erases
features.level-select-or-daily: Easy, Medium and Hard on the title, plus a Daily puzzle that is the same for everyone each day
features.results: Solved card with mistakes, time, best time, streak, hints used, badges, rank and daily streak
